intent.proves: At least one active customer price group, customer discount group or product discount group exists.
intent.scope: active rows of EcomCustomerPriceGroups, EcomCustomerDiscountGroups and EcomProductDiscountGroups

bindings.reason: No MCP read tool or Admin query for price or discount groups was measured on a 10.30.6 host; a binding needs a measured tool and row projection.

bindings.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomCustomerPriceGroups WHERE CustomerPriceGroupIsActive = 1) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomCustomerDiscountGroups WHERE CustomerDiscountGroupIsActive = 1) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomProductDiscountGroups WHERE ProductDiscountGroupIsActive = 1)
